hook.en: Five hundred people apply for thirty jobs. How does a company fairly choose the best thirty? Through a series of hurdles called the selection process.
hook.kn: ಮೂವತ್ತು ಹುದ್ದೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಐನೂರು ಅರ್ಜಿಗಳು. ಉತ್ತಮ ಮೂವತ್ತು ಜನರನ್ನು ನ್ಯಾಯಯುತವಾಗಿ ಹೇಗೆ ಆರಿಸುವುದು? ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಎಂಬ ಹಂತಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ.

objectives.en: Name the kinds of selection tests

narration.en: Five hundred people apply for thirty jobs. How does a company fairly choose the best thirty? Through a series of hurdles called the selection process.
narration.kn: ಮೂವತ್ತು ಹುದ್ದೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಐನೂರು ಅರ್ಜಿಗಳು. ಉತ್ತಮ ಮೂವತ್ತು ಜನರನ್ನು ನ್ಯಾಯಯುತವಾಗಿ ಹೇಗೆ ಆರಿಸುವುದು? ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಎಂಬ ಹಂತಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ.

body.en: Selection is choosing the best candidates from the pool of applicants. Its steps are: preliminary screening; selection tests; employment interview; reference and background checks; selection decision; medical examination; job offer; and contract of employment.

narration.en: Selection is choosing the best candidates from the pool of applicants. Its steps are: preliminary screening; selection tests; employment interview; reference and background checks; selection decision; medical examination; job offer; and contract of employment.
narration.kn: ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಅರ್ಜಿದಾರರಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ತಮರನ್ನು ಆರಿಸುವುದು. ಪ್ರಾಥಮಿಕ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ, ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ, ಸಂದರ್ಶನ, ಹಿನ್ನೆಲೆ ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ, ಆಯ್ಕೆ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ, ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ತಪಾಸಣೆ, ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಆಫರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಒಪ್ಪಂದ.

title.en: On the board: selection as a funnel

narration.en: Watch the board as we build this up step by step.

say.en: Think of selection as a funnel: many enter at the top, few come out.
Selection tests: intelligence, aptitude, personality, trade and interest. 200 become 100.
Then selection decision, medical examination, job offer and contract.

narration.en: Match each selection test to what it measures.

prompt.en: Match each selection test to what it measures.
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯನ್ನು ಅದು ಅಳೆಯುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ.

explanation.en: Different tests check different things; together with the interview they help pick the best candidate.

right.en: IQ: the ability to reason and judge
The potential to learn new skills
Existing skill, such as a typing speed test
Likes and dislikes about kinds of work

body.en: An intelligence test measures IQ. An aptitude test measures the potential to learn new skills. A personality test probes emotions, maturity and values. A trade test measures existing knowledge and skill. An interest test finds a person's likes and dislikes about work.

mnemonic.en: "Smart Students In Rural Schools Make Jolly Changes"

caption.en: The selection funnel: how many survive each stage?

narration.en: Set the number of applicants and the pass rate at each stage. Watch the funnel shrink.

tryThis.en: With 500 applicants at 40%, 50% and 30%, how many are selected?
To fill 50 posts with the same pass rates, how many applicants do you need?
Why is selection called a negative process?

problem.en: 500 people apply. 40% pass screening, 50% of those pass the tests and 30% of those pass the interview. How many are selected, and what is the selection ratio?

answer.en: 30 candidates are selected; the selection ratio is 6%.

narration.en: Let us work through this case together. 500 people apply. 40% pass screening, 50% of those pass the tests and 30% of those pass the interview. How many are selected, and what is the selection ratio?
Class quiz. Discuss in your benches, raise hands, and the monitor taps the class answer.
narration.kn: ತರಗತಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಬೆಂಚಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ, ಕೈ ಎತ್ತಿ, ಮಾನಿಟರ್ ತರಗತಿಯ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಲಿ.

narration.en: Now some CBSE board pattern questions: assertion–reason and case based.

points.en: Selection chooses the best from the applicants: a negative process.
points.kn: ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಅರ್ಜಿದಾರರಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ತಮರನ್ನು ಆರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ: ನಕಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ.

points.en: Screening, tests and interview remove unsuitable candidates.
Medical examination comes before the job offer and contract.
points.kn: ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಆಫರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಒಪ್ಪಂದಕ್ಕೆ ಮೊದಲು ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ತಪಾಸಣೆ.

homework.en: Explain the steps in the selection process.

narration.en: Recap. Selection chooses the best from the applicants: a negative process. Screening, tests and interview remove unsuitable candidates. Medical examination comes before the job offer and contract.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಅರ್ಜಿದಾರರಲ್ಲಿ ಉತ್ತಮರನ್ನು ಆರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ: ನಕಾರಾತ್ಮಕ ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆ. ಪರಿಶೀಲನೆ, ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ, ಸಂದರ್ಶನ ಅನರ್ಹರನ್ನು ತೆಗೆಯುತ್ತವೆ. ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಆಫರ್ ಮತ್ತು ಒಪ್ಪಂದಕ್ಕೆ ಮೊದಲು ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ತಪಾಸಣೆ.
